messages:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout: auth-service v3.0.0-rc2 -> 10% traffic us-east-2. change-window 2026-03-24 05:00-06:00 UTC. notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/auth/3.0.0-rc2

lee: noticing p99 auth latency jump and a cluster of token refresh failures. p99 ~1.2s vs baseline 240ms.

parul: confirm. traces show long wait on redis AUTH calls; also a small increase in redis `BUSY` responses. Could be client pooling behavior in rc2.

infra-bot: Alert: auth-service us-east-2 5xx spike (policy=AUTH-5xx). Automated gating recommends manual pause.

oncall: please pause and pin staged cohort to v2.9.8 while triage happens.

lee: issuing pause/pin: `/release pause service=auth-service cohort=staged version=v2.9.8 reason="redis busy / token refresh failures"`

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 10%. Cohort pinned to v2.9.8. action_id=rl-4923456789-pause

infra-bot: Routing update confirmed. Telemetry will backfill in ~45s.

parul: after pin, errors drop to baseline and p99 back to ~260ms. I'll collect redis client metrics and open a PR to revert the pooling change if confirmed.

oncall: acknowledged. I'll monitor the change-window and escalate if noise returns.

lee: thanks team 1: keeping thread open for triage updates."
